case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Attributable human/group responsibility and traceable disclosure of relevant AI assistance. Access differences become critical where a required tool blocks participation without a workable alternative.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: N002 s.2.8.1 requires group submissions to declare each member's responsibilities, N136/N133 prohibit unapproved or undisclosed GenAI use, N001 Principle 3 requires equity/inclusion, and discretionary general-purpose AI use does not block participation without an alternative.
case_summary.case_note: Curtin requires group work submissions to declare which members are responsible for which portions (N002 s.2.8.1), prohibits unapproved or undisclosed GenAI use (N133, N136, N141), and upholds equity and inclusion in AI (N001). Because discretionary general-purpose AI use does not block participation and attribution/disclosure rules are operative, S7's critical risk is protected (D5=3, Critical gap=No). Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.

Principle 3: Fairness
Develop, deploy and use AI systems so there is no unfair
discrimination against individuals, communities or groups. Train and
test models used by AI Systems on relevant, accurate and
appropriate datasets. Train users to deploy and use AI systems
responsibly to manage and mitigate bias. Enable access, inclusion
and equity in AI systems throughout their lifecycle.
